changelog: Autonomous Conversation Workspace Self-Healing: automatically detects and rewrites legacy/foreign Android package paths (e.g. /data/user/0/ai.antigem/...) inside imported .antigem/.lytsocoder chats (protobuf trajectory_metadata_blob + conversation_summaries.db) on import, bridge startup, chat send, and terminal launch — eliminating terminal hangs on shared chats
100% independent standalone Lytso/LytsoCoder ecosystem with clean history, renamed lytsocoder-* submodules, and unified Lytso attribution

Pixel-perfect mathematical 1:1 README.md app logo: rendered exact W3C SVG feGaussianBlur (3.4 & 1.4), 6-stop Neon Rainbow gradient and obsidian atmospheric auras to lossless 540x540 adaptive-icon layers (ic_launcher_background_img & ic_launcher_foreground_img) wired into adaptive-icon XML and AppIconImage

Hot-reload AI Root access in 0ms (no app or hub restart): dynamic ai_bin_guard shims (su/sudo/tsu) now read ~/.lytsocoder/root_enabled live on every shell call, search Magisk/KernelSU/APatch su paths, and automatically push an authoritative Live AI Permissions & Root Status update into active chats on the very next turn

Auto-sanitized legacy /data/user/0/ai.antigem/ workspace, project and built-in context paths to the current LytsoCoder package directory (lytso.code) so shell commands never fail with permission denied on stale workspaces
Fixed All files storage access toggle state refresh on resume in AI Permissions & Root settings

Unified Prompts & Context Hub (Identity · Built-in · Custom): merged System Prompt, Built-in Environment Context and Custom Rules into one clean tabbed screen with clear visual priority hierarchy, spacious open editors, and a full-screen Custom Rule editor (zero cramped AlertDialogs)

Re-architected artifact & message CRUD with 0ms Optimistic UI, a single serialized Mutation Queue with automatic coalescing/batching (POST /artifacts/delete-batch), automatic retries, and clean rollback on permanent failure — completely eliminating Antigravity Disconnected errors during rapid clicks
Added Multi-Select & atomic batch deletion in the Artifacts drawer (Select button + long-press, Select all / Clear, single atomic Delete) plus 1-tap instant deletion

Fixed Mini-Apps SDK runtime bridge: exposed both window.LytsoCoder and window.AntiGem (including background workers & threads) and republished all 9 signed mini-apps (fixing Gallery photos/folders/stats)

Cleaned and modularized File Explorer Places menu: removed hardcoded Downloads/Documents/Camera/Pictures/Movies/Music clutter and duplicate projects row, locked core defaults (Home, Lytso Home, Projects, conditional Internal storage), and added inline Add folder / Remove custom folder controls
Replaced all remaining brain emojis with the native Material Psychology icon in System Prompt and Context Compacted UI
Restored the exact 1:1 README.md Neon Rainbow terminal (>_) app launcher logo without altered borders or shrinking
Dynamically synchronized AI Root access, modular capabilities and custom File Explorer roots into the live system context (zero prompt contradictions)
Switched CI & companion repos to Release-only signed distribution builds (no debug APK publishing)
Fixed Chromium extension MV3 manifest icons (16/32/48/128px), alarm interval and badge contrast

Added Global System Prompt in Settings → Agents → System prompt (and a "Set Global" button in the chat 🧠 System Prompt dialog): applies automatically to every chat without its own override, while chats with custom overrides always keep theirs

Improved the chat 🧠 System Prompt dialog: "Active Prompt" now shows the real active prompt (Per-chat override, Global system prompt, or Agent default) with clear source labels and a didactic guide comparing System Prompt vs. Global Context

Chat System Prompt now genuinely replaces Antigravity's default <identity> and persona via CustomAgentConfig (exclude_default_components = true) with AGENT_MESSAGE_ORIGIN_SDK_EXECUTABLE, preserving all native coding tools without repeating the prompt on every user message

Cleaned up Antigravity chat context noise via CustomizationDiscoveryConfig: disabled unused built-in skills, plugins, subagents, rules, hooks, workflows, and isolated jarvis_mcp from normal chats while keeping user-enabled MCPs active

Fixed the "CustomAgentSpec is only allowed to specify builtin_agent" delivery error on chats with a Chat System Prompt: the prompt is now injected hidden in front of the message and framed as replacing the default persona
Fixed "Rewind & resend" on the first message of a chat: its text (and files) now land in the message box instead of being wiped when the chat switches to a fresh one
Much faster CI/release builds: arm64 and x86_64 build in parallel on separate runners, unit tests and Go tests run alongside, and the Go bridge build is now incremental and cacheable
Fixed user message editing showing hidden <lytsocoder-expansion> / <antigem-expansion> app context blocks instead of only the user's message
Swapped Rewind & resend and Save in place buttons in the user message edit dialog
Introduced minimalist Neon Rainbow terminal (>_ ) logo unified across launcher icon, splash animation, and README
Added special Rainbow AMOLED dark theme with true #000000 AMOLED surfaces and prismatic neon UI accents
Published signed non-debug Release APKs for both arm64 and x86_64
Added x86_64 support for emulators and Chromebooks (-Pabi=x86_64, per-ABI glibc runtime, seccomp shim, Linux x64 agy launcher)
Synced multi-account AGY switcher, EGM (/egm), Gemmy mascot, Pinned Chats, and Compose BOM 2026.11.01
Kept Enhanced Conversation Control and Android 11+ seccomp-safe Go bridge process management (pkg/procutil)
